description: This file contains Flask templating utilities, including custom Jinja2 environment and loader classes, and functions for rendering templates and streaming responses within a Flask application.

classes.name: Environment
classes.description: Custom Jinja2 environment class with Flask-specific behavior, such as handling blueprint template paths.

classes.name: DispatchingJinjaLoader
classes.description: A Jinja2 loader that searches in the application and all blueprints for templates, with explanation and fast-loading options.

methods.name: _default_template_ctx_processor
methods.description: Provides default context variables like request, session, and g for templates.

methods.name: __init__ (Environment)
methods.description: Initializes the custom Flask-aware Jinja2 environment.

methods.name: __init__ (DispatchingJinjaLoader)
methods.description: Initializes the loader that searches across app and blueprints.

methods.name: get_source
methods.description: Retrieves the source code for a given template, with explanation if configured.

methods.name: _get_source_explained
methods.description: Provides detailed attempts to locate a template, with debugging.

methods.name: _get_source_fast
methods.description: Quickly retrieves template source, raising if not found.

methods.name: _iter_loaders
methods.description: Iterates over app and blueprint loaders for templates.

methods.name: list_templates
methods.description: Lists all templates available in the app and blueprints.

methods.name: _render
methods.description: Renders a template with context, sending signals before and after.

methods.name: render_template
methods.description: Renders a template by name or list with provided context.

methods.name: render_template_string
methods.description: Renders a template from a source string with provided context.

methods.name: _stream
methods.description: Streams the output of a template rendering with context, with signals.

methods.name: stream_template
methods.description: Streams a template by name or list with context.

methods.name: stream_template_string
methods.description: Streams a template from a source string with context.
